The decision (keep the built-in grinder after the burr checks, add a budget espresso grinder, or add a single-dose grinder) can be answered from supported claims. Both machines use 54 mm portafilters. The Express's built-in grinder shares its 40 mm burr group with the Smart Grinder Pro (CoffeeGeek), which makes that grinder a sideways move. The Pro instead uses Baratza burrs. The Encore ESP has a 40 mm M2 espresso range and is sold in the US and GB, and the DF54 (54 mm flat, stepless, low retention per the reviewer) is sold in both markets.
